mission: Persistent heartbeat selection semantics across source DOM and native source contract without P0/phone consumption or duplicate owner architecture.

materialFindings.finding: Existing heartbeat source specimen no longer exposes persistent one-of-many selection as aria-pressed toggle state. Radios are direct children of the radiogroup, selection uses aria-checked, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End navigation, and inert detail projection.

HeartbeatSelectionAccessibilityPolicy defines one single-selection native collection from the accepted UI-ready model. Regnet/platform review corrected the first draft: Android horizontal-list collection geometry is rows=itemCount, columns=1, with item rowIndex=index and columnIndex=0. Source-level positionInSet remains one-based human/set order.

Authenticated OperatorOverlayService still carries Button.setSelected(...) only. No explicit native collection/item semantics are wired. Direct owner probe therefore classifies the native persistent-selection seam PARTIAL_UNSAFE, and an intentionally RED owner boundary remains unexecuted.

persistent-selection-semantics and heartbeat-native-selection-collection now carry the corrected persistent one-of-many law. The older heartbeat-skill-lights doctrine still contains stale aria-pressed wording; the specialized persistent-selection laws explicitly supersede it, but that stale text remains a future cleanup wound rather than being silently called converged.

selfCorrections: First native source draft transposed Android horizontal collection geometry into one row/many columns; corrected to many rows/one column after platform review.
First DOM radio repair left li wrappers between radiogroup and radios; corrected to direct radio children and pinned by source regression.
